Hello ,  

I hope you are doing well. 

I have a question for you and I hope your answer for my questions will help me to solve my problems.

Researcher has been using an R package bnlearn to produce DAGs in Bayesian network modeling. 
1.Can we use RINLA  to identify optimal DAGs among the vast number of different possible DAG structures? 
2. Can we use an R package abn for standard Bayesian networks? some of the authors mention that an R package abn aiming at performing an ABN(Additive Bayesian Network) analysis.
